//: Module-boundary rules for the project graph, in Nx's depConstraints shape. A project tagged sourceTag may depend (Cargo dependency of any kind, or Nx implicitDependency) only on projects carrying one of onlyDependOnTags. Enforced by tools/check-project-boundaries.mjs inside workspace:lint. The point: the published gh-secrets crate (type:app) can never be made to depend on a test, live or bench project, which would drag the expensive suites behind every change and ship test code.
